description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 用 Win顺 0.44.0 的共用窗口代码重新编译：窗口重新创建后照样保持边框、阴影和深色标题栏，任务栏和 `Alt+Tab` 里显示应用自己的图标；列表滚动时滚动条会亮起来。权限不变。
notes.en: Rebuilt with WinShun 0.44.0's shared window code: windows keep their border, shadow and dark title bar when they are made anew, and show the app's own icon on the taskbar and in `Alt+Tab`; list scroll bars light up while scrolling. Permissions unchanged.
